results.qualification: Exact accepted improvement (blocked 4-row fftA intermediate); 50 ms target not met and shown to be below the measured M5 floor for this exact formulation.
results.accepted_change: fftA intermediate stored as [bf][row/4][col 0..256][row%4]; pass 1 writes 32-byte segments; pass 2 uses 256-thread groups (4 rows) with a coalesced block load, padded threadgroup tile, register prefetch of the next BF, 2 barriers per BF. Per-value arithmetic and per-pixel BF accumulation order unchanged.
results.variance_note: Blocked-4 per-call loss spans about 221-279 ms versus 250-256 ms for the previous path in the same session; p50/p95 improved in 8 of 9 interleaved pairs.
